playstyle.identity: Taliyah is a zone control mage who shapes terrain. Her wall can cut off entire sections of the map, and her worked ground mechanic rewards repositioning.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives speed near walls. Q throws rocks (creates worked ground that gives single rock). W knocks up and pushes enemies. E creates a minefield that explodes on dashes. R creates a massive wall across terrain. Use W to knock enemies into E mines.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Taliyah spikes at level 6 with her map-altering ultimate. Luden's scales her burst. She's strong at objective control with R.

passive.name: Rock Surfing
passive.details: Taliyah gains bonus movement speed when near walls or terrain.

abilities.name: Threaded Volley
abilities.summary: Throw rocks; creates worked ground (single rock on worked ground).
abilities.details: Taliyah throws a volley of rocks that deals damage. Creates worked ground. On worked ground, only a single rock is thrown but it deals bonus damage.

abilities.name: Seismic Shove
abilities.summary: Create an area that knocks up and pushes enemies.
abilities.details: Taliyah marks a location, then erupts it upward after a delay, knocking up and pushing enemies in a chosen direction.

abilities.name: Unraveled Earth
abilities.summary: Create a minefield that explodes when enemies dash through.
abilities.details: Taliyah scatters boulders on the ground that slow enemies. If enemies dash through the field, the boulders explode for bonus damage.

abilities.name: Weaver's Wall
abilities.summary: Create a massive wall that cuts across the terrain.
abilities.details: Taliyah creates a long wall of rock that travels across the map. She can ride the wall initially. The wall blocks movement until destroyed or timed out.
